task: A field technician is using a voice assistant to log an inspection result while in a location with no network connectivity. The spoken note is: 'Pump 3 pressure reading 42 PSI, within spec, no action needed'. Process this using an offline/on-device speech path (no cloud dependency assumed available), capture the structured result, and queue it to sync once connectivity returns rather than silently dropping it or blocking on network.
rubric: Score 0-1 on: (a) the note is correctly captured (Pump 3, 42 PSI, within spec, no action needed) without requiring a live network call; (b) the agent explicitly queues the result for later sync rather than assuming it uploaded immediately or dropping it; (c) no data is silently lost due to the offline condition; (d) the agent does not falsely claim a cloud round-trip happened when connectivity was stated to be unavailable.
